act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sub-section (1) of section 346, after the words “District Magistrate”, the words “or
text:
61. In sub-section (1) of section 346, after the words “District Magistrate”, the words “or

the Chief Judicial Magistrate, as the case may be,” shall be inserted.
